title: dipsacus fullonum subsp. ferox
intro: Dipsacus fullonum subsp. ferox, commonly known as Echium plant or more specifically, Fuller's teasel or Fuller's teasel, is a flowering plant in the teasel family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Dipsacus fullonum subsp. ferox include its use as an antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
